_comment: Copy this to servers.json and edit the paths. The 'mcpServers' key and the
{command, args, env, cwd} / {url, headers} shapes are what desktop hosts use,
so a config that works here mostly works there.
Paths below are relative to code/10-mcp-client, which means they only resolve
when you run from that directory. Use absolute paths in a real config: the
host that spawns your server will not share your working directory.
